kld.text: Pia Nalaar's story in Kaladesh begins with loss: Captain Baral's troops burned Burarat, killing her husband Kiran, taking Chandra to be executed and jailing Pia. In her cell Baral tells her he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack as a memento, but Pia knocks off his mask with an aether lamp, and answers his anger over his scars by saying a mother could not be prouder of Chandra's work.

Years later, Pia has rallied a growing contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether. At the Inventors' Fair her renegades launch nearly a hundred thopters, but Tezzeret seizes her with his metal claw, and when she sees Chandra, grown and unmistakable, she announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to protect her.
Liliana pulls Chandra away as the soldiers drag Pia off, and Oviya Pashiri promises Chandra they will free her mother, then learns Pia is held at Dhund prison, where Baral is stationed.

The next noon, banners advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar. Tezzeret sets his automaton to kill Pia, but a bolt of fire from the audience fells it, and Chandra leaps into the arena, declaring she will not lose her again. With the Gatewatch supporting her, Tezzeret slips away, and Chandra runs into her mother's arms.

aer.text: In Aether Revolt, Pia Nalaar mourns that the Consulate has seized the inventors' workshops and creations, and she leads the Renegades as they revolt and seize large parts of Ghirapur to overthrow it. The renegades win ground at first, though Baral baits Chandra into leaving the hub and the Consulate counterattacks and retakes it.

When the renegades attack the Aether Spire in three teams, Dovin Baan disables the disruptor, but Pia's gremlins disable the cannon. After Tezzeret's final defeat the Consulate yields to the Renegades, and Pia is named consul of Allocation while Baral is imprisoned in the Dhund.
Pia is also remembered for building the thopter Hope of Ghirapur with Saheeli against Tezzeret's bridge, and for her part in the Indigo Revolution that installed the Avishkar Assembly.

dft.text: Pia Nalaar appears in Aetherdrift as the Aether Rangers' mechanic, revealing that she has upgraded Spitfire's racer with advanced aether systems while her daughter Chandra wishes her all the best, as long as the best is second place. At a pit stop Pia teases Chandra as her turncoat daughter, laments that she will not wear an Aether Ranger uniform, and gives Spitfire a new aether-powered racing suit.

Later Pia picks the lock to free Loot and Daretti from a cage after crumbling a raider who finds Chandra hiding, and Chandra's fireball blows up half the raiders' camp as they escape in a ride that crashes across the border through an Omenpath.

Stranded on Amonkhet, Pia, Chandra and Daretti build an all-new engine from palm fibers, hippo bones and scrap, with Pia making Chandra her welding torch. Pia asks why Chandra did not race with the Aether Rangers and comforts her, telling her they find other ways to be.

Falling toward Ghirapur, they find the crowd panicking and Pia identifies the guards as Consulate thugs. The guards seize Pia and put a blade to her throat until Sita breaks free and disarms them, and Chandra, Pia and Sita fight together as Team Avishkar.
